name: Jin Tong Ling Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Jin Tong Ling Technology Group Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells blowers, compressors, steam turbines, and boilers in China and internationally. The company offers industrial fans, centrifugal compressors, industrial boilers, and small steam turbines; and system integration products, such as air system reconstruction integration, pressure air station system integration, biomass gasification cogeneration system integration, and waste heat and gas cogeneration system integration.It also provides CNC vertical lathe, CNC heavy lathe, CNC lathe, CNC grinder, Five-axis machining center, Kehren grinder, Niles gear grinding machine, End Milling Machine, CNC plasma cutting, Boring and Milling machine,…
